name: Mechanical Insight
body:
School divination; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a small silver pendulum)

EFFECTS

Range 60 ft.
Target one touched device with an area of up to 10 cu. ft./level or the designs for such a device.
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell grants you, or a designated ally who is also touching the device or designs, insight into the inner workings of a complex machine, trap, or clockwork device.

You, or the designated ally, may add a +4 enhancement bonus to the next Disable Device check you or the ally make when working with the device, or you or the ally gains a + 4 enhancement bonus to the next attempt to craft a replica of the device. Enhancement bonuses provided by this spell do not stack with enhancement bonuses from other sources.
